messages:
maya: FYI Acme Europe wants to add their UK subsidiary as a signer on the order form and insert a short AML-sanctions clause into the MSA. They also asked for invoice send-to to be the UK entity for VAT reasons. Can legal/procurement advise on blockers?

carla_legal: We can do a 1-page addendum that lists the additional signing entity and limits AML obligations to transaction-level screening + sanctions compliance checks. Need exact legal name + VAT/UTR for the UK entity. Avoid any new indemnities or escrow obligations.

devin_procure: Procurement: we need PO number and remit instructions to match the invoicing entity. If invoicing switches to UK entity, our billing team will route differently. Finance prefers Net30; customer asked Net60 for enterprise accounts.

sam_eng: Tech gating: for Dedicated POC we can't provide any VPN or console creds until the DPA amendment that covers the new entity is signed. That's non-negotiable.

chloe_cs: Customer prefers internal e-sign tool with HSM audit trail, but will accept DocuSign if we include an amendment to migrate signatures to HSM later. Do we support signature migration?

carla_legal: Yes. Add clause: "Interim e-signature via DocuSign permitted. Parties may migrate to HSM-backed signature workflow upon mutual written agreement; migration does not affect contract effective date." Keeps change simple.

devin_procure: For PO we need a field on order form: `PO required: yes` and billing contact + VAT ID. Also confirm if cross-entity signing (UK signing for VAT and US parent signing order value) is acceptable.

maya: Buyer wants two signers: UK legal rep + US finance. Is that allowed?

carla_legal: Cross-entity signing is allowed if the addendum maps each entity to its responsibilities (invoicing, data processing). I will include a signing matrix mapping signer -> invoicing entity -> processing scope.

sam_eng: Reiterating: no POC access until DPA amendment is executed and countersigned. Please tag infra-bot once signed so we can trigger provisioning.

infra-bot: pending action: wait for docu-bot event `esign-complete` + DPA-signed flag to flip.

docu-bot: created envelope id env-4201 for `orderform-acme-uk` (DocuSign)  awaiting signatures.

chloe_cs: I'll request VAT/UTR and legal full name from the buyer and update here. Also I'll propose Net30 + 1% early-pay credit to bridge to their Net60 request.

devin_procure: Finance says Net30 default; escalate to credit if they need Net60. Also need to confirm tax withholding rules for UK invoicing.

maya: checklist for next steps: 1) Acme UK legal name + VAT/UTR (chloe) 2) addendum + DPA amendment draft (carla) 3) PO field + billing snippet on orderform (devin) 4) interim DocuSign envelope (docu-bot) 5) provisioning hold until DPA signed (sam/infra-bot).

chloe_cs: Acme replied: "Acme Europe Ltd." VAT GB987654321. Billing contact invoices-uk@acme.example.co.uk.

carla_legal: Thanks. I'll drop a redline PR with the addendum and DPA patch in ~90 minutes and include the signature migration clause + signing matrix.

docu-bot: envelope env-4201 updated: legal signer completed, awaiting finance signer.

maya: holding kickoff until signed order form + DPA. we can run internal preflight while legal reviews. Thanks everyone. :pray:
